chunks: Everything in this book that is narrated from ʿAlī ibn al-Faḍl al-Wāsiṭī, I have transmitted from my father—may Allah have mercy on him—from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from ʿAlī ibn al-Faḍl al-Wāsiṭī, the companion of al-Riḍā عليه السلام.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father, a link in the chain of transmission
key_terms.صَاحِبِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: companion of Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام
key_terms.عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْفَضْلِ الْوَاسِطِيِّ: the named transmitter to whom this chain leads

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAlī ibn al-Faḍl al-Wāsiṭī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from ʿAlī ibn al-Faḍl al-Wāsiṭī. It serves as a transmission-chain notice in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh and identifies al-Wāsiṭī as a companion of Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام.
